stage: Adapter contract accepted before implementation. Installed behavior, renderer and performance acceptance remain separate.

sourceBoundaries.name: executeProc

imports.resource:
import {gainWard as engineGainWard} from '@hollow-wake/engine/combat/effects';
import {wardResourcePorts} from './procEffectAdapter';
imports.effect:
import {applyWardEffect as engineApplyWardEffect} from '@hollow-wake/engine/combat/effects';
import {wardEffectPorts} from './procEffectAdapter';

ownership.magnitude: Return SDK scaleProcEffect through the existing data function, with the native full effect type asserted only at this schema boundary.
ownership.resource: Actor.gainWard delegates to SDK gainWard using one shared resource port object.
ownership.effect: Only the native ward switch case delegates arithmetic to applyWardEffect; original noteProcCue and rider tail remain in place.
ownership.binding: One stateless shared resource/effect port pair. Actor is a type-only import, so importing the binding cannot instantiate or import Actor at runtime.

ports.effect: maximumLife(actor) calls actor.maxLife(); gain(actor,amount) calls the current actor.gainWard method.

checksBeforeWrites: Require one parseable owner and target method/function, and the exact accepted method hash.
Require the accepted ward case and all 21 sibling case hashes.
Reject reserved binding names, an existing binding file, and repeated integration.
Render and validate all three source edits before writing any of the four files. Filesystem write errors are not promised to be atomic.
preservation: Keep all method signatures and unrelated declarations/members unchanged.
Keep the native proc power/context query, cue construction, non-ward cases and rider tail unchanged.
Keep Actor.gainWard observable; the effect gain port calls its current method.
Keep each existing source file newline style and unrelated appended source.
Use a fresh candidate with independent installed dependencies. Never modify retained controls or the original game.

requirements: Source guard faults rejected before writes in LF and CRLF.
All unchanged original fixtures compared through the installed SDK; no expected-output regeneration.
Meaningful installed faults detected, including bypassed observation hooks.
Game, launcher and simulation type checks; smoke and affected native probes.
Existing integration comparisons retained; actual frame-to-ward-to-HUD acceptance.
Measured workload receipts with competing heavy jobs stopped.
Managed-game preservation, final package consumers and exact-commit hosted checks before publication.

scope: Magnitude folding applies to all native proc payloads. Only ward application and the gainWard resource method move in this adapter; the other 21 executor branches, delayed resolution and full effect schemas remain in scope for subsequent work.
